Features: Off peak demand charge dependent on on-peak demand
Example Utility & Rate: Minnesota Power, Schedule 75 - Pilot Rider for Large Light and Power Service
Exact Language: The Off-Peak Demand is defined as the difference between the maximum kW measured during the 15-minute period of the customer’s greatest use (On-Peak or Off-Peak) during the current month, as adjusted for power factor, and the On-Peak Billing Demand.

Example Utility & Rate: Georgia Power, Power and Light Small Schedule PLS-18
Exact Language:
All consumption (kWh) not greater than 200 hours times the billing demand; All consumption (kWh) in excess of 200
hours and not greater than 400 hours
times the billing demand

Example Utility & Rate: Knoxville Utilities Board, GSA-TOU General Power Time-of-Use Rate
Exact Language: The Billing Demand for any month shall be the higher of the following: a) Metered Demand b) 85 percent of the load in kVA c) 30 percent of the higher of the currently effective contract demand or the highest billing demand established during the preceding 12 months.

Example Utility & Rate: United Illuminating Company, Large Power Time-of-Use Rate LPT
Exact Language: Peak demand charge: The greatest demand registered during the Peak hours of the month, but not less than 80% of the Peak Demand in the preceding months of June through September.

Features: TOU and tiered charges within the same rate
Example Utility & Rate: Southern California Edison, TOU-D-T Time-of-Use Tiered rate
Exact Language: Need to track both how much energy you used in each TOU period and how that energy relates to your baseline tier thresholds.

Example Utility & Rate: Salt River Project, Large General Service Rate E-61
Exact Language: Monthly charge is $1,248.08 for the first meter, and $33.78 for each additional meter

Example Utility & Rate: Santee Cooper, Large Light and Power L-25-LL
Exact Language: The Firm Billing Demand for each Billing Month shall be greater of (i) On-Peak Measured Demand, or (ii) the Firm Contract Demand multiplied by the then-current Minimum Firm Billing Demand Factor

Features: Fixed credit for specific range of kWh usage
Exact Language: Bill credit of X dollars kicks in upon using 1000 kWh in a billing cycle
